args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18 after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed** — `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (and v2.2.9) were healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back** — rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident** — created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but it was a staging release, so it wasn't a candidate for rollback.
